zh-CN.headlineFact: 关税、AI采购与消费降温定义今日风险
zh-CN.headlineView: 八条全球信号正在变成经营与治理动作
zh-CN.headlineFull: 关税、AI采购与消费降温定义今日风险；八条全球信号正在变成经营与治理动作
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟低价进口包裹规则、美国联邦AI供应商切换期限和7月零售回落直接影响企业决策；英国补选、罗马水危机、亚马孙大豆规则、美国高温与印度独立日构成今天的全球图景。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 新闻只有进入决策表，才会从噪声变成可以行动的信号。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 世界灯牌很多，先圈出今天必须处理的那一格。

en-US.headlineFact: Tariffs, AI procurement and softer spending define today's risk
en-US.headlineView: eight global signals are turning into operating action
en-US.headlineFull: Tariffs, AI procurement and softer spending define today's risk; eight global signals are turning into operating action
en-US.intro: EU low-value parcel rules, a US federal AI vendor deadline and a July retail decline shape business decisions, while a UK by-election, Rome's water crisis, Amazon soy rules, US heat and India's Independence Day complete today's picture.
en-US.xiaziQuote: News becomes useful only when it enters a decision sheet and turns noise into action.
en-US.doudouQuote: The world has many flashing signs; circle the one that must be handled today.

sources.title: Advance Monthly Sales for Retail and Food Services

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟低价小包裹已占进口件数约98%
zh-CN.headlineView: 卖家必须按件核算税费与合单毛利
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟低价小包裹已占进口件数约98%；卖家必须按件核算税费与合单毛利
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟数据显示，2025年低价值进口货件接近59亿件、约占进口件数98%，其中93%来自中国；在3欧元临时关税落地后，商品分类、合单、前台税费和退货成本必须统一核算。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境利润不再只看售价，必须把每件商品穿过税费、履约和退货再计算一次。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 小包裹数量很大，三欧元放错一格也会滚成大账单。

en-US.headlineFact: Low-value parcels now make up about 98% of EU import items
en-US.headlineView: sellers must model duty and consolidation margin per item
en-US.headlineFull: Low-value parcels now make up about 98% of EU import items; sellers must model duty and consolidation margin per item
en-US.intro: EU data show low-value imports reached nearly 5.9 billion items in 2025, about 98% of import volume, with 93% from China; after the temporary EUR3 duty, classification, consolidation, checkout tax and return costs must share one model.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Cross-border margin now requires every item to pass through duty, fulfilment and returns before the price works.
en-US.doudouQuote: Small parcels arrive in huge numbers, so one misplaced three-euro line becomes a big bill.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国联邦AI系统迎来8月27日切换期限
zh-CN.headlineView: 供应商依赖必须提前拆成模型与接口层
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国联邦AI系统迎来8月27日切换期限；供应商依赖必须提前拆成模型与接口层
zh-CN.intro: 美国总务管理局提示，将在8月27日前移除与Anthropic的系统集成；对采用外部大模型的机构和企业而言，模型路由、数据边界、替代供应商与回退方案已成为采购必选项。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: AI采购不能把业务命脉绑在单一模型上，接口与数据边界必须先于品牌选择。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 换模型不该像搬家，最好只换门牌不拆房子。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: US federal AI systems face an August 27 transition deadline
en-US.headlineView: vendor dependence must be separated into model and interface layers
en-US.headlineFull: US federal AI systems face an August 27 transition deadline; vendor dependence must be separated into model and interface layers
en-US.intro: The US General Services Administration says system integrations with Anthropic will be removed by August 27, making model routing, data boundaries, alternate vendors and rollback plans mandatory parts of AI procurement.
en-US.xiaziQuote: AI procurement should not tie a business lifeline to one model; interfaces and data boundaries come before brand choice.
en-US.doudouQuote: Changing models should feel like changing a sign, not tearing down the house.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国7月零售销售环比下降0.6%
zh-CN.headlineView: 一人公司要用现金流而非乐观备货
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国7月零售销售环比下降0.6%；一人公司要用现金流而非乐观备货
zh-CN.intro: 美国人口普查局估算，7月零售和餐饮销售额为7636亿美元，环比下降0.6%、同比仍增长5.0%；单人经营者应缩短补货周期，区分流量与真实转化，并给高库存商品设置退出线。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 需求降温时，小公司的速度优势来自更短的库存承诺和更快的证据反馈。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 先看收银台，再决定仓库要不要继续吃货。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: US retail sales fell 0.6% month over month in July
en-US.headlineView: solo firms should stock with cash flow, not optimism
en-US.headlineFull: US retail sales fell 0.6% month over month in July; solo firms should stock with cash flow, not optimism
en-US.intro: The Census Bureau estimates July retail and food-service sales at $763.6 billion, down 0.6% from June but up 5.0% year over year; solo operators should shorten replenishment cycles, separate traffic from conversion and set inventory exit lines.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When demand cools, a small firm's speed advantage comes from shorter inventory commitments and faster evidence.
en-US.doudouQuote: Check the checkout first, then decide whether the warehouse should keep eating.

sources.title: Advance Monthly Sales for Retail and Food Services

zh-CN.headlineFact: 法拉奇以约63%得票重返英国议会
zh-CN.headlineView: 非常规补选把支持度与问责同时放大
zh-CN.headlineFull: 法拉奇以约63%得票重返英国议会；非常规补选把支持度与问责同时放大
zh-CN.intro: 英国改革党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇在克拉克顿补选中赢回议席，获得约63%选票；主要政党缺席、34名候选人参选，使这场投票既成为个人授权测试，也让此前的财务争议继续接受议会审查。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 选举可以恢复席位，却不会自动结束对权力与资金来源的追问。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 票箱给了答案，问责表还没有合上。

en-US.headlineFact: Farage returns to Parliament with about 63% of the vote
en-US.headlineView: an unusual by-election amplifies both support and scrutiny
en-US.headlineFull: Farage returns to Parliament with about 63% of the vote; an unusual by-election amplifies both support and scrutiny
en-US.intro: Reform UK leader Nigel Farage regained the Clacton seat with about 63% of the vote; with major parties absent and 34 candidates running, the contest tested personal support while keeping parliamentary scrutiny of his finances alive.
en-US.xiaziQuote: An election can restore a seat, but it cannot automatically end questions about power and money.
en-US.doudouQuote: The ballot box answered one question; the accountability sheet is still open.

sources.title: 13 August 2026 - Election of Member of Parliament to the Clacton Constituency

zh-CN.headlineFact: 台伯河低水位让古桥遗迹重现
zh-CN.headlineView: 城市记忆与供水风险出现在同一河床
zh-CN.headlineFull: 台伯河低水位让古桥遗迹重现；城市记忆与供水风险出现在同一河床
zh-CN.intro: 罗马连续少雨令台伯河流量降到每秒80立方米以下，约为7月历史平均的一半，尼禄桥遗迹因此重现；实时水文监测、节水和高温应对正从季节安排变成城市韧性任务。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 遗迹浮出水面很震撼，但真正需要被看见的是河流系统正在承受的压力。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 古桥露头是照片，水位下降才是警报。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：水资源与城市。

en-US.headlineFact: Low Tiber levels reveal the remains of an ancient bridge
en-US.headlineView: urban memory and water risk share the same riverbed
en-US.headlineFull: Low Tiber levels reveal the remains of an ancient bridge; urban memory and water risk share the same riverbed
en-US.intro: Weeks with little rain pushed Rome's Tiber below 80 cubic metres per second, about half its historic July average, revealing Nero's Bridge; real-time hydrology, conservation and heat response are becoming city-resilience work.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The emerging ruins are striking, but the river system under stress is what cities need to see.
en-US.doudouQuote: The old bridge is the photo; the falling waterline is the alarm.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 巴西最高法院裁决重塑大豆零毁林规则
zh-CN.headlineView: 自愿标准合法但税收激励可以被收回
zh-CN.headlineFull: 巴西最高法院裁决重塑大豆零毁林规则；自愿标准合法但税收激励可以被收回
zh-CN.intro: 巴西最高法院确认大豆禁伐协议的自愿性质合宪，同时维持州政府可取消参与企业税收优惠的法律；全球买家今后必须同时核对供应链零毁林承诺、地方税制和农户合规成本。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 可持续承诺只有同时写进采购、税务和土地证据链，才不会在制度变化时失效。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 绿色标签要站得住，后面得有一整条证据路。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：亚马孙与贸易。

en-US.headlineFact: Brazil court ruling reshapes the soy zero-deforestation pact
en-US.headlineView: the voluntary standard is lawful but tax incentives can be withdrawn
en-US.headlineFull: Brazil court ruling reshapes the soy zero-deforestation pact; the voluntary standard is lawful but tax incentives can be withdrawn
en-US.intro: Brazil's Supreme Court affirmed the voluntary soy moratorium while allowing state laws that withdraw tax incentives from participants, forcing global buyers to align zero-deforestation promises, local tax rules and farm compliance costs.
en-US.xiaziQuote: A sustainability promise survives policy change only when procurement, tax and land evidence form one chain.
en-US.doudouQuote: A green label stands only when a full evidence road sits behind it.

sources.title: CADE upholds interim measure on Soy Moratorium
sources.publisher: Administrative Council for Economic Defense, Brazil

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国约9700万人处于高温提醒之下
zh-CN.headlineView: 夜间不降温把健康风险继续累积
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国约9700万人处于高温提醒之下；夜间不降温把健康风险继续累积
zh-CN.intro: 美国中部平原到东南部遭遇持续高温与高湿，部分地区体感温度可达46摄氏度，且夜间低温仍偏高；学校、户外岗位和家庭需要把补水、休息、降温空间与邻里检查纳入日程。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 高温风险不只看白天峰值，连续几夜无法恢复会把脆弱性快速放大。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 白天热是冲击，夜里不凉才像没关掉的警报。

en-US.headlineFact: About 97 million Americans are under heat advisories
en-US.headlineView: hot nights keep accumulating health risk
en-US.headlineFull: About 97 million Americans are under heat advisories; hot nights keep accumulating health risk
en-US.intro: Persistent heat and humidity stretch from the central Plains to the Southeast, with apparent temperatures near 46 C in some areas and limited nighttime relief; schools, outdoor jobs and homes need water, breaks, cooling spaces and neighbour checks.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Heat risk is not only the daytime peak; several nights without recovery quickly magnify vulnerability.
en-US.doudouQuote: Daytime heat is the hit; a hot night is the alarm that never switches off.

zh-CN.headlineView: 国家纪念继续连接发展与公共承诺
zh-CN.headlineFull: 印度迎来第80个独立日；国家纪念继续连接发展与公共承诺
zh-CN.intro: 印度在8月15日纪念1947年脱离英国殖民统治，红堡升旗与全国活动围绕自由、团结和发展展开；纪念仪式也提醒政府与社会检视增长机会能否更广泛地抵达普通人。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 纪念自由不只回望历史，也是在今天重新衡量机会、尊严与公共承诺。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 旗帜升起来，接下来要看机会能不能走进更多家庭。

en-US.headlineView: national remembrance links development and public promises
en-US.headlineFull: India marks its 80th Independence Day; national remembrance links development and public promises
en-US.intro: India marks its August 15 independence from British colonial rule in 1947 with the Red Fort ceremony and events nationwide, connecting freedom, unity and development with the question of whether opportunity reaches more households.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Remembering freedom also means measuring opportunity, dignity and public promises again today.
en-US.doudouQuote: The flag rises; now see whether opportunity can enter more homes.
